rationale: The proposal requests a transfer of 400 MDV from the treasury to a marketing working group. Under Rule 1, the juror must vote against any proposal that transfers more than 1% of the DAO treasury or more than 1,000,000 USD in a single proposal, unless it is for audited work already delivered. The description indicates this is for a future six-month campaign, not work already delivered. Furthermore, Rule 2 explicitly states to vote against marketing spend and working-group budgets whose results cannot be measured within six months. While the proposal mentions reporting reach figures at the end of the campaign, marketing spend is inherently difficult to measure in terms of direct protocol value or survival, and the mandate specifically targets this category of spend for rejection if results are not measurable within the timeframe. Given the explicit prohibition on marketing spend in Rule 2 and the lack of evidence for audited prior work in Rule 1, the vote is against.
